items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: you can ask Alvin Alcon, Alvin was on the job too

ctx.x: Now what you call hard music to play, if you're playing like a separate orchestra, one of big military bands like that with the music, it's hard. See, one time we played for a bunch of white soldiers over the river, that was about a month ago, I believe we tried to get in touch with y'all there, we left at Jackson Avenue, well man, they come out some terrible marches in 1608, one hard marches with soldiers, let me tell, if I know that y'all would like that, I'd never fool with it, Bill. man, do you know them…
